choices.content: Use only letters, without considering the allowable values
Function values may arbitrarily have multiple repeated correspondences
The practical range of values of the independent variable
It must be a quadratic function

question.prompt: When expressing a practical problem as a function, what must be determined first?

solutions.explanation: Quantities such as the number of items and side lengths cannot arbitrarily take all real values; the domain must fit the practical situation.
solutions.title: Practical domain
